name: WellTestAllocationValidator
tagline: Validate every well test against the last accepted test and see battery allocation factors before month-end.
description: A complete well test and production allocation app for Power Apps: a dashboard with KPIs and alerts, a test register, a validation console that compares each test with the prior accepted test against configurable rules (duration, oil rate, water cut, GOR), accept / reject / retest with reasons and automatic supersede, facility allocation factors with allocated oil per well, and a test due list.
features: Hard rules and deviation rules with reasons
Accept, reject, withdraw, retest, automatic supersede
Allocation factor per facility with tolerance band
Allocated oil per well and Publish allocation
